# nano vs Lean: hand-written boundary cases (generated by `python3 Testing/nano/edge.py 0 5 --table`)

Lean = real frontend (`import Init` only), nano = `nanoElab`. `value` = the result on the first input vector (UInt64 bits). Cases with the
prelude `H` have `def g (a b) := a - b`, `def h (a) := a * 3`, `def k := 7` before the entry `f (x y z)`. Verdict: ok = same, nano stricter =
nano rejects what Lean accepts (allowed), BUG = nano accepts what Lean rejects or values differ (none).
